name: Collège de France
text: The Collège de France (French pronunciation: [kɔlɛʒ də fʁɑ̃s]; formerly known as Collège royal or Collège impérial or Collège des trois langues), founded in 1530 by Francis I of France, is a higher education and research establishment (grand établissement) in France. It is located in Paris near La Sorbonne. The Collège de France has been considered to be France's most prestigious research establishment.
